description.to:
As a household member, I want to look up a named bot by user and name after a Front Door recycle, so I can recover bot_id without listing every roster row.

Feature: Bot turns pin to the user's computer

Scenario: A named bot can be looked up after a Front Door recycle
  Given an empty control plane backed by a durable messaging store with HTTP
  And tenant "anthus" user "ryan" has a bot named "Researcher"
  When a recycled Front Door serves the same messaging store
  Then tenant "anthus" can look up bot "Researcher" for user "ryan"

Not included: staging, production, Fargate, Safari.
